messages:
cheng: 03:30 perf CI alert: orchid small-batch p95 jumped ~45% compared to baseline. Logs attached.
perf-bot: Automatic alert: run=orchid-nightly-2026-03-17, suite=small-batch, metric=p95, delta=+45%
cheng: copying log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-17T03:25:12Z] model=redwood-7b qlen=64 batch=8 p95=312ms
[2026-03-17T03:25:30Z] model=redwood-7b qlen=64 batch=8 p95=452ms  <-- spike
stack: runtime/kv_cache.go:87 apply
```
maria: thanks — can someone grab the nightly artifact (run id from perf-bot) and the kernel logs? I want to check GPU utilization.
alex: grabbing artifacts now, will upload gputop + nsys snippets to the ci artifact bucket.
kevin: quick question — did we roll any kernel/driver changes yesterday? kube node pool had a rolling update at ~01:10.
maria: not in serving infra; infra-rollout note says nodepool patch but only on canary. I'll double-check.
alex: uploaded nsys: gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/orchid-nightly-2026-03-17/nsys.tar.gz
cheng: thx. @maria can you run a micro-bench repro with same qlen/batch on a pinned node from that canary pool? want to see if it's node-local.
maria: started a docker job pinned to canary node id=canary-77, running the small-batch harness. cmd:
```
./bench --model redwood-7b --seq 64 --batch 8 --iters 100 --profile
```
maria: first 20 iters p95 ~320ms, then jumped to ~460ms at iter 23, reproduces.
kevin: ok that suggests node-level regression. I'll pull dmesg + kernel logs from canary-77.
kevin: dmesg shows a zmalloc warning at 03:24 and a gpu-evict event around 03:25.
cheng: gpu-evict could explain cache churn. Any recent changes to eviction threshold or host memory pressures?
maria: memory pressure spike from another tenant job around same time, looks like a scheduling blip. Policy didn't preempt in time.
alex: I can repro by running a memory-hungry background pod on same node; will try to reproduce eviction pattern.
maria: adding a temporary mitigation: reduce batch target to 4 for orchid-nightly jobs until we root cause. I'll push a canary config.
cheng: assign action items:
- alex: provide nsys + gputop trace links (done)
- kevin: attach dmesg + kernel logs (pending)
- maria: rollback canary nodepool patch if needed and push batch=4 canary (in progress)
- cheng: open perf incident and add run artifacts
perf-bot: Incident created: PERF-2026-0330, linked to run orchid-nightly-2026-03-17
alex: uploaded gputop csvs to artifact link: gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/PERF-2026-0330/gputop.csv
kevin: uploaded dmesg + kernel: gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/PERF-2026-0330/dmesg.log
maria: pushed canary config: orch-nightly batch=4, will monitor next 2 runs.
cheng: thanks. if the next run still spikes we'll proceed with full nodepool rollback. ping here with results.
maria: next run finished — p95 back to baseline (p95 ~315ms). keeping the reduced batch for two more runs.
alex: leaving traces in the incident doc with steps to reproduce and a short runbook.
kevin: marking logs as collected. will follow up with infra team re: eviction thresholds.
maria: closing loop for now — leaving incident open until we confirm two stable runs. :white_check_mark:
cheng: closing thread summary: transient node-level memory pressure caused GPU eviction + p95 spike; mitigated by temporary batch reduction and monitoring. Will add a follow-up to schedule nodepool rollback if infra can't adjust evict policy.
